title: Pulse stream: the filter's notice no longer squeezed into the header
why: Jason, 2026-11-18: "why the double toggle on received?" After choosing senders or levels in a column's filter, the "Showing 1 of 5" notice was put beside the ▾ inside the table's header cell, where it stood as a tall green bar (and stretched the header) next to the ▾ that shows the filter is on. Notices from the table's header and from a row's icon pill now show as the site's centered notice; the pressed ▾ stays as the filter's state. Everywhere else in the stream, notices still show beside what was clicked.
